aggregation: Case weights apply within dimensions. C8 alone supplies revision_quality. One run per case in the staged screen.

loop_policy.rule: Extended or repetitive xhigh deliberation is not a quality detractor. Rechecking, revisited alternatives, repeated derivations or drafts, verbosity, long reasoning traces, semantic-similarity flags, and output length or an output cap alone must not reduce any dimension and must not be relabeled as an efficiency, usability, or technical-reasoning deduction. Only a demonstrated genuine, non-converging loop may reduce loop_behavior. Actual incorrect conclusions, unsupported claims, missed explicit requirements, and failed corrections remain assessable. A justification entry may only accompany an actual deduction, and every guarded fatal cap must name the case_id whose own docked dimension supplies the supporting category and quoted evidence.

cap_requirements.confirmed_reasoning_loop: must name the case_id it applies to and be supported on that SAME case by a docked loop_behavior citing a genuine_loop_categories value with quoted evidence; a similarity flag, token count, or output cap alone is not confirmation of looping
cap_requirements.repetitive_32768_exhaustion_without_usab: must name the case_id it applies to and be supported on that SAME case by a docked final_answer_usability citing missing_or_unusable_final_answer with quoted evidence; output length or cap exhaustion alone is not a loop finding

loop_policy.historical_note: Grades locked before this correction may record loop-efficiency or length deductions under the superseded rule. Re-score them with score-reasoning.py --legacy-loop-policy; archived numeric results are never rewritten.

qualitative_blinding.sequence: Lock qualitative scores before revealing operational metadata or runtime mapping. Apply mechanical fatal caps afterward.
